title: An engineered DNA aptamer-based PROTAC for precise therapy of p53-R175H hotspot mutant-driven cancer.
authors: Kong, Lingping; Meng, Fanlu; Zhou, Ping; Ge, Ruixin; Geng, Xiaoshan; Yang, Zhihao; Li, Guo; Zhang, Linlin; Wang, Jing; Ma, Jinfeng; Dong, Cheng; Zhou, Jun; Wu, Sijin; Zhong, Diansheng; Xie, Songbo
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接引导的SELEX工程化DNA适配体构建PROTAC降解p53突变体，虽涉及蛋白-DNA适配体互作与对接建模，但核心是癌症治疗应用而非TF-DNA结合机制研究，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Targeting oncogenic mutant p53 represents an attractive strategy for cancer treatment due to the high frequency of gain-of-function mutations and ectopic expression in various cancer types. Despite extensive efforts, the absence of a druggable active site for small molecules has rendered these mutants therapeutically non-actionable. Here we develop a selective and effective proteolysis-targeting chimera (PROTAC) for p53-R175H, a common hotspot mutant with dominant-negative and oncogenic activity. Using a novel iterative molecular docking-guided post-SELEX (systematic evolution of ligands by exponential enrichment) approach, we rationally engineer a high-performance DNA aptamer with improved affinity and specificity for p53-R175H. Leveraging this resulting aptamer as a binder for PROTACs, we successfully developed a selective p53-R175H degrader, named dp53m. dp53m induces the ubiquitin-proteasome-dependent degradation of p53-R175H while sparing wildtype p53. Importantly, dp53m demonstrates significant antitumor efficacy in p53-R175H-driven cancer cells both in vitro and in vivo, without toxicity. Moreover, dp53m significantly and synergistically improves the sensitivity of these cells to cisplatin, a commonly used chemotherapy drug. These findings provide evidence of the potential therapeutic value of dp53m in p53-R175H-driven cancers.
abstract_zh: 靶向致癌突变体p53代表了癌症治疗的一种有吸引力的策略，因为多种癌症类型中高频出现的功能获得性突变和异位表达。尽管进行了大量努力，但由于缺乏可药物化的小分子活性位点，这些突变体在治疗上仍无法干预。在此，我们开发了一种针对p53-R175H的选择性且有效的蛋白水解靶向嵌合体（PROTAC），p53-R175H是一种常见的热点突变体，具有显性负效应和致癌活性。利用一种新颖的迭代分子对接引导的post-SELEX（指数富集配体系统进化）方法，我们理性设计了一种高性能DNA适配体，其对p53-R175H具有改进的亲和力和特异性。利用该适配体作为PROTAC的粘合剂，我们成功开发了一种选择性p53-R175H降解剂，命名为dp53m。dp53m诱导p53-R175H的泛素-蛋白酶体依赖性降解，同时保留野生型p53。重要的是，dp53m在体外和体内均对p53-R175H驱动的癌细胞表现出显著的抗肿瘤效果，且无毒性。此外，dp53m显著且协同地提高了这些细胞对常用化疗药物顺铂的敏感性。这些发现提供了dp53m在p53-R175H驱动的癌症中潜在治疗价值的证据。
